mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with HOUST above the 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6.0% in the past month, it signals economic weakness that triggers a sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0%) indicates a monetary policy response to a weakening labor market, which typically precedes a market downturn due to reduced corporate investment and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and UNRATE > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of industrial contraction (INDPRO < 105.0), which signals a weakening manufacturing sector, S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days are negative due to reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS) indicates a healthy labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate revenues, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS above the 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) fall below $550 billion, it signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when RSAFS < 550000.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1500) and industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500 and INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 260.0) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the S&P 500 tends to experience positive returns over the next 60 days as the central bank maintains accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL < 260.0 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.
